what_worked: Slide 5's null-result on social-vs-revenue growth is a genuinely useful contrarian finding worth exploring.
fix_next: Replace fabricated sample sizes and correlations with actual 1,000-row dataset figures; add real charts instead of placeholder images.
verdict: Consulting-flavored template with fabricated statistics, no real charts, and a placeholder image.
factual_error_detail: Slide 1: claims 5,000+ listings, dataset has 1,000. Slide 2: '99.9% MoM revenue scaling' unsupported. Slide 3: anonymous ~20% vs actual 12.9% (129/1000). Slide 4: r=0.43 for DR-revenue with n=5,130 — sample size fabricated, correlation unverifiable. Slide 5: n=233 longitudinal startups fabricated. Slide 6: Revenue vs Time r=0.48 with n=5,567 — reference shows r≈0.025 with n=984; all four sample sizes fabricated. Slide 6: '81% revenue outpaced followers' unverifiable.

evidence.insight: Slide 5 null-result (r=-0.03 social vs revenue) is interesting if true, and slide 7 translates correlations into actionable investor heuristics. But most claims (CAC, NRR, gross margins) are asserted without dataset grounding.
evidence.narrative: Loose arc from market overview to correlations to playbook exists, but slides 2-3 are disconnected assertion cards. No synthesis or limitations slide. The jump from unsupported bullet claims to a buyout strategy is not earned by evidence.
evidence.framing: Slide 1 identifies audience (Micro-PE investors) which is good. But dataset is misidentified as 5,000+ rows and '2026 Telemetry.' No missingness, zero-revenue, or scope limitations are disclosed. A cold reader would be fundamentally misled.
evidence.accuracy: Nearly every quantitative claim is fabricated or wrong. Revenue vs Time r=0.48 contradicts reference r≈0.025. All sample sizes (5,567, 5,130, 4,410, 233) are invented — dataset has 1,000 rows. Anonymous share stated ~20% vs actual 12.9%. The 99.9% MoM claim is unsupported.
evidence.visual: Slide 2 has a literal placeholder image ('600 × 400'). Zero actual data visualizations in the entire deck — no scatter plots, bar charts, or distributions. Identical dark card layouts repeated across every slide. Hero r-values are the only quantitative display, and they appear fabricated.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive consulting buzzwords: 'compounding organic distribution,' 'defensive moats,' 'algorithmic due diligence,' 'expansion NRR,' 'near-zero CAC.' Placeholder image left in. Fabricated precise sample sizes suggest AI generation without verification. Template card layouts repeated identically.

change_reason: Lowered narrative by 0.5 (no synthesis, disconnected middle slides) and visual by 0.5 (placeholder image is more damaging than preliminary credited; zero real charts in entire deck). Other scores confirmed as appropriate.
